Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full store-pickup payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Pick up in store","product":{"name":"Trailblazer Running Shoe","variant":"Size 10 · Black","imageUrl":"/resource/asaRetailTrailblazerShoe","category":"shoes"},"stores":[{"id":"s1","name":"Union Square","distance":"0.4 mi","availability":"in_stock","pickupEta":"Ready in 2 hours","address":"333 Post St, San Francisco","hours":"Open until 9:00 PM","phone":"+14155550142","mapsUrl":"https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=..."}]}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading at the top of the card. Defaults to 'Pick up in store'.
- 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short line under the title.
- 'product' (object, optional): the item being picked up, shown as a context row above the store list. Optional fields: 'name' (string; the row only renders when present), 'variant' (string, e.g. size/color), 'imageUrl' (string, same-origin https URL or '/resource/<Name>'; use '/resource/asaRetailTrailblazerShoe' for the sample shoe), 'category' (string; one of 'apparel','shoes','electronics','beauty','home','grocery','accessories','outdoors','toys'; drives the fallback tile when no image is available).
- 'stores' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): the nearby stores to choose from. Each store MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back when the customer picks it) and 'name' (string). Optional per store: 'distance' (string, e.g. '0.4 mi'); 'address' (string); 'hours' (string, e.g. 'Open until 9:00 PM'); 'availability' (string; one of 'in_stock','low','out'; 'out' stores are shown but cannot be selected); 'pickupEta' (string, e.g. 'Ready in 2 hours'; hidden when 'out'); 'phone' (string; rendered as a tappable Call link); 'mapsUrl' (string; rendered as a Directions link, opened in a new tab).
- 'submitText' (string, optional): label for the reserve button. Defaults to 'Reserve for pickup'.

Never emit zero stores. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
